newsitem.title: TAIWAN: PRESS DIGEST - Taiwan newspapers - March 10.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Taiwan newspapers - March 10.

text.p: These are the leading stories in the Taiwan press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
CHINA TIMES - Pro-unification New Party expels key member Ju Gao-jeng
Guangzhou reports bomb explosion in bus after similar one in Beijing
UNITED DAILY NEWS - Tariffs on small passenger cars may be reduced to 15 percent within nine years after Taiwan becomes World Trade Organization member
LIBERTY TIMES - New Party expels Ju Gao-jeng
COMMERCIAL TIMES - Communications ministry may commit to work out timetable for liberalising telecommunication market
Taiwan holds talks with United States and Canada on WTO membership bid
ECONOMIC DAILY NEWS - Council for Economic Planning and Development planning to allow private sector to operate special trade and business zones from November 1999
Some new insurance companies found to be in deficit in past three years
